title: Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.00705v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. translated_title: 面向自动驾驶应用的交互式策略快速自适应的元多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种元多智能体强化学习框架，以实现多智能体系统中交互式策略的快速自适应。元强化学习通过双层优化机制使智能体能够快速适应新任务/新环境。然而，现有的元强化学习通常聚焦于单智能体系统。将这些框架和算法扩展到多智能体系统会带来额外的挑战，因为任务不仅由环境决定，还由智能体之间的策略性交互所决定。为应对这些挑战，我们将多智能体强化学习问题建模为马尔可夫博弈，并开发了一个元MARL框架，用于在马尔可夫博弈分布上实现交互式策略的快速自适应。本文定义了一个新概念——元纳什均衡，用于描述元MARL问题中期望的解概念，并给出了元纳什均衡与标准均衡之间等价的充分条件。
tldr: 本文提出一种元多智能体强化学习框架，通过将MARL问题建模为马尔可夫博弈并定义元纳什均衡这一新解概念，实现多智能体交互式策略在新任务上的快速自适应，并应用于自动驾驶场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that models MARL problems as Markov games and introduces a new meta-NE solution concept to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies, with applications to autonomous driving.
